title: Add hierarchical token sampling and latency tiling for long-tail SLO analysis
author: Lucas Cheng
commits: a1c8b2a: initial hierarchical sampler and tiled latency model
d4f9e33: instrumented sampler metrics and added sampler config API
b27c9d0: dashboards: latency-tiling panels and drilldowns
e98a1ff: tests and rollout script; docs for runtime flags
description:
Motivation: We observe long-tail latency/cost regressions driven by small subsets of invocations (particular prompt shapes, streaming patterns, or large prefix KV cache misses). Current sampling is uniform and misses signal in those cohorts. This PR introduces a hierarchical token-sampling strategy plus a latency-tiling dashboard to make long-tail SLO analysis cheaper and more precise.

What this changes: 1) New runtime component (token_sampler) that maintains lightweight cohort sketches keyed by a stable invocation fingerprint, supports stratified sampling rates (global -> tenant -> cohort) and emits sample markers for traces/metrics. 2) Tiled latency model: latency is bucketted into sequence-length x prefix-warmth tiles so heatmaps and SLOs can be decomposed along both axes. 3) Dashboard artifacts: new latency_tiling panels and a sampler overview that link from tiles to sampled trace IDs. 4) Config surface: a config_schema.yaml mapping linear keys to sampling policy; rollout script for staged enablement. 5) Tests and docs.

Implementation notes: - Hierarchical sampler keeps in-memory count-min sketches (approximate) per tenant and global aggregate; sampling decisions are fast-path and annotated on request context. - Sampler emits tags: telemetry.sampled=true/false, telemetry.cohort=<cohort-id>, sampling.rate=<r>. - Latency tiling adds derived metrics: runtime.latency.tile.{len_bucket}.{warmth_bucket} and runtime.token_count.tile.{len_bucket}.{warmth_bucket}. - Dashboards are compatible with existing span IDs and link to trace viewer via sample anchors.

Migration & rollout: - Default sampler is disabled. Rollout is incremental: enable at 1% global -> 5% tenant cohort -> 50% targeted cohorts. scripts/rollout/telemetry-rollout.sh automates canary subsets and verifies metric continuity. - Backwards compatibility: absence of telemetry.sampled tag falls back to existing collectors.

Testing & CI: unit tests cover sampling logic and tile bucketing; integration test bootstraps the sampler with synthetic traffic and asserts trace anchoring and metric emission. CI had an initial flaky test (test_token_sampler::cohort_decay) which was fixed by adding a deterministic RNG seeding; full pipeline passed on rerun.

Checklist: - [x] Runtime sampling implementation
- [x] Metric emission & labeling
- [x] Latency-tiling dashboards + drilldowns
- [x] Rollout tooling and docs
- [x] Unit/integration tests

Related: ENG-1892 (long-tail SLO tooling), ENG-2201 (dashboard panel conventions), SUP-3421 (customer report mentioning noisy tenant).
